name: Mantine
licence: MIT (github.com/mantinedev/mantine, Copyright 2021 Vitaly Rtishchev). Studied @mantine/core 9.7.1 at commit f7ab1ef (2026-10-08). Default palette derives from Open Color (MIT).
bestFor: internal tools, admin panels, dashboards and data-heavy SaaS product UI
teams that want one 10-shade colour per hue and a predictable size ladder with minimal design work
apps needing many ready components (dates, charts, notifications, spotlight, rich text, dropzone, schedule)
avoidFor: brand-led marketing sites or campaign pages (default look is recognisably 'Mantine blue + system font')
products that need a distinctive type voice out of the box (ships with a system font stack only)
projects that cannot adopt its component API or CSS-modules/PostCSS-preset toolchain

families: sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, Apple Color Emoji, Segoe UI Emoji
mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, Liberation Mono, Courier New, monospace
headings: same stack as sans (separately overridable via theme.headings.fontFamily)
typography.notes: Two parallel scales: fontSizes xs-xl = 12/14/16/18/20px (rem 0.75/0.875/1/1.125/1.25) with lineHeights xs-xl = 1.4/1.45/1.55/1.6/1.65 (line-height grows with size, applied together by Text via --text-fz and --text-lh), and headings h1-h6 = 34/26/22/18/16/14px with line-height 1.3/1.35/1.4/1.45/1.5/1.5 (line-height shrinks as size grows). fontWeights regular 400, medium 600 (not 500), bold 700; headings default 700. Body is size md (16px) / 1.55. No letter-spacing tokens: tracking is 0 everywhere except Badge (uppercase, bold, 0.25px, shown as 0.25/11 = 0.0227em). Button uses text-box-trim (text-box-edge cap alphabetic) on label for optical centring. theme.scale (default 1) multiplies every rem-derived value via calc(x * var(--mantine-scale)). Button label size follows the control size (xs 12, sm 14, md 16, lg 18, xl 20).

accents.note: 13 hues x 10 shades, index 0 lightest to 9 darkest. Default primaryColor = blue.

light.input default: bg white, border gray-4, focus border = primary filled

role-to-shade-map (per colour, light sch.outline: shade 6, hover bg = shade-6 at 5% alpha

color.darkMode: Attribute-driven (data-mantine-color-scheme = light | dark | auto, colour-scheme managers, ColorSchemeScript to avoid flash). Not an inversion: a separate neutral 'dark' ramp (#C9C9C9 text on #242424 body, never pure black) plus a separate primaryShade (light 6, dark 8). Every role (text, dimmed, placeholder, error, anchor, default, disabled) is re-pointed per scheme through CSS variables. Hue ramps themselves are shared; only the shade index and a few derived values (light-variant bg via darken, text at shade 4) change. 'Virtual colors' (virtualColor({name, light, dark})) let one colour name resolve to different ramps per scheme.
color.contrastNotes: Measured (WCAG relative luminance, this study): white on blue-6 filled (#228be6) = 3.56:1, below 4.5:1 for 14px text; in dark scheme white on blue-8 (#1971c2) = 5.02:1. Light-variant text blue-9 on blue-1 = 4.93:1. dimmed text gray-6 on white = 3.32:1 and placeholder gray-5 on white = 2.07:1 (both fail AA for body text; placeholder is conventionally exempt, dimmed is not). Dark scheme: dark-0 on dark-7 = 9.37:1, dimmed dark-2 on dark-7 = 4.04:1. The default filled text is white regardless of fill; autoContrast (default false) flips to black when relative luminance of the fill >= luminanceThreshold 0.3 (the standalone isLightColor helper defaults to 0.179). Yellow, lime, cyan fills therefore need autoContrast or an explicit c prop.

spacing.base: no fixed grid: named steps in rem multiplied by theme.scale. xs 10px, sm 12px, md 16px, lg 20px, xl 32px. Component internals use raw px (30/36/42/50/60 heights, 5/6/8/10/13 input padding-y).

radius.rule: One global knob: theme.defaultRadius (default 'md' = 8px) exposed as --mantine-radius-default; Button, Input, Paper, Card and Notification read it unless a radius prop overrides. Radius prop accepts a scale key or any CSS length. Badge is the exception: its radius is a hard-coded 1000px pill (--badge-radius). No nested-radius arithmetic (unlike Chakra/Park l1-l3).

depth.borders: 1px solid everywhere by default. Light: gray-3 (Paper, Tabs, Table) / gray-4 (inputs, default button). Dark: dark-4. Paper has withBorder prop; Card has none by default. Outline variants use 1px of the filled colour.
depth.blur: Not part of the theme. Overlay is a flat rgba scrim; Button loading state uses a 12px blur highlight sweep (::before filter blur(12px)). Z-index tokens: app 100, modal 200, popover 300, overlay 400, max 9999.

motion.notes: Not tokenised on the theme: durations are hard-coded per component. Button label/loader slide 150ms transform + 100ms opacity, Switch 150ms, Accordion chevron 200ms, Tooltip fade 100ms (10ms inside a tooltip group), Popover fade 150ms, Modal fade-down 200ms, generic Transition 250ms. Press feedback: .mantine-active translateY(1px) on :active (disabled inside disabled fieldset). theme.respectReducedMotion (default false) opts into prefers-reduced-motion via data-respect-reduced-motion + data-reduce-motion attributes: reduced-motion is OFF unless enabled by the developer.

list: (plus newer: ActionBar, Cascader, DataList, EmptyState, FloatingWindow, Marquee, MaskInput, Menubar, OverflowList, RollingNumber, Splitter, TableOfContents, Toolbar, Tour, TreeSelect)
(satellite packages: dates, charts, notifications, spotlight, carousel, dropzone, code-highlight, tiptap, schedule, form, hooks, nprogress, modals)
components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Strong on size x variant x colour for Button/ActionIcon/Badge/Alert/Avatar/Chip/ThemeIcon (variants filled, light, outline, subtle, transparent, white, gradient, default; five sizes; any theme colour or CSS colour; all derived by variantColorResolver). Input family: variants default, filled, unstyled (custom variants addable via data-variant); states default, hover(filled bg), focus (border = primary), error (border + text + placeholder + section colour), success, disabled (3-token disabled set), loading (Button), pressed (translateY 1px). Focus ring documented (2px, offset 2px, :focus-visible only). Explicit pressed/hover tokens exist only for the derived variants, not as a standalone state table. Sizes are exposed as data-size attributes and per-component CSS variables so custom sizes are addable without forking.

tokenArchitecture: Three layers. (1) JS theme object (createTheme / MantineProvider): colors (10-tuple per hue), primaryColor, primaryShade {light,dark}, fontSizes, lineHeights, spacing, radius, shadows, breakpoints (36/48/62/75/88em), headings, scale, focusRing, autoContrast, luminanceThreshold, variantColorResolver, components (default props + Styles API overrides). (2) Generated CSS variables on :root and [data-mantine-color-scheme]: --mantine-color-{name}-{0..9}, derived role variables --mantine-color-{name}-filled / -filled-hover / -light / -light-hover / -light-color / -outline / -outline-hover / -text, plus --mantine-primary-color-*, --mantine-spacing-*, --mantine-font-size-*, --mantine-radius-*, --mantine-shadow-*. (3) Per-component CSS-module files that read component-scoped variables (--button-height, --button-bg, --input-bd...) which are set from size/variant/color props through a vars resolver; styling hooks are data-* attributes (data-variant, data-size, data-disabled, data-loading, data-error). Naming: --mantine-{category}-{key}; colours always {hue}-{index}.
distinctiveness: Recognisable by: system-font stack, Open-Color-derived hues, 36px default control, 8px radius, 1px gray-4 borders, filled blue button with white 14px/600 label, label-above-input pattern with a small red asterisk, and its shadows with large negative spread. Its genuine systemic idea is the colour contract: any hue becomes a complete system (7 variants, light + dark) from only 10 hex values and two indices. Otherwise visually generic-clean (a neutral 'SaaS admin' look).
weaknesses: Default type is a system font stack: no typographic identity without an override
Default white-on-blue-6 filled button is 3.56:1, below WCAG AA for 14px text; autoContrast is off by default
dimmed text (gray-6, 3.32:1) and placeholder (gray-5, 2.07:1) are weak on white
Spacing scale is irregular (10/12/16/20/32): not a 4px grid and no scale below 10px, so tight layouts rely on raw px
Motion is untokenised (per-component literals) and reduced-motion is opt-in (respectReducedMotion false)
Radius and shadow are scale keys only; no nested-radius rule
Component library is large and opinionated; look diverges from brand quickly when mixed with marketing pages
takeaways: Encode colour as a 10-step ramp plus ROLE -> INDEX maps (filled 6/8, hover +1, light bg 1, light text 9, dark text 4), not as raw hex per use. Any brand hue then yields every variant automatically.
Give light and dark mode their own primary-shade index instead of reusing one fill (light 6, dark 8) so contrast holds in both.
Bind all controls to one size ladder with matching heights (30/36/42/50/60) so a Button and an Input of the same size align on one baseline; expose compact variants separately.
Make the variant a pure function (color, variant, scheme) -> {background, hover, text, border}; add variants by adding branches, not by editing components.
Expose one global radius knob (defaultRadius) read by every component; change character in one line.
Treat disabled as a three-token set (bg, text, border) and error/success as border + text + placeholder + icon colour changes together.
Make auto-contrast an explicit luminance-threshold rule (0.3) rather than hoping every brand colour takes white text.
Pair font-size steps with their own line-height steps (1.4 at 12px up to 1.65 at 20px) while headings tighten as they grow (1.5 at 14px down to 1.3 at 34px).
